title: Show HN: A new kind of FPS aim trainer
summary: A web-based FPS aim trainer that analyzes raw crosshair movement patterns to identify a player's motor and perceptual weaknesses, rather than just scoring performance. It dynamically adapts sensitivity and difficulty settings while creating personalized training playlists optimized for each user's learning curve.
problem_solved: Traditional aim trainers score scenarios but fail to identify WHY players underperform or adapt training to their specific weaknesses.
why_valuable: By analyzing raw movement data and personalizing difficulty, it provides targeted training that accelerates skill acquisition compared to generic aim practice tools.
